summary: Implemented internal/config with a Config struct and Load(path) that applies defaults on a missing file, overrides fields from present YAML, and returns a descriptive error on malformed YAML.

files_changed.description: Config{ListenAddr, LogLevel string}. Load(path) starts from defaults (":8080", "info"), returns them unchanged with nil error if os.Stat reports the file missing, otherwise reads and yaml.Unmarshal's the file into a copy of the defaults (so unset fields keep their default), returning a wrapped error on unmarshal failure.
Tests: missing file returns defaults; sample-config.yaml overrides both fields; malformed YAML returns a non-nil error and nil Config.
Fixture: deliberately invalid YAML (unterminated list) for the error-path test.
